title: In 1956, 5 Megabytes Weighed More Than a Ton

scenes.text: In 1956, five megabytes weighed more than a ton.
It was IBM's RAMAC, the first hard drive.
Inside were fifty metal disks, each 24 inches wide.
It had to be moved with forklifts.
Renting it cost 3,200 dollars every month.
A single phone photo can use that much. Look at that size again.

description:
In 1956, IBM's RAMAC stored about five megabytes on fifty disks, and the drive weighed more than a ton.
It leased for 3,200 dollars a month.
A single phone photo can use that much space today.
How much storage is on your phone?
first_comment: How many gigabytes are on your phone right now?
